title: S3 bucket allows public read access
description: Customer data bucket 'prod-uploads' has a public-read bucket policy exposing objects to unauthenticated users.

title: MFA not enforced for privileged IAM users
description: Two IAM users with AdministratorAccess do not have MFA devices attached.

title: No documented incident response plan
description: Gap assessment found no formal incident response plan covering detection triage and post-incident review.

title: Vendor lacks SOC 2 report
description: Payment processor vendor could not provide a current SOC 2 Type II report during annual vendor review.

title: CloudTrail logging disabled in one region
description: CloudTrail is not enabled in ca-central-1 leaving API activity in that region unlogged.

title: Offboarding checklist missing access revocation step
description: Review found terminated employees retained VPN access for up to five days past termination.
